user.title: HA Pilote Com
user.description:
Set up automatic sending of your solar data to Romande Dynamics.

Power sensors (W) are used for live display. Energy meters (kWh) are optional but provide more accurate historical curves.

data_description.production_entity: Instantaneous PV power in watts — used for live display
data_description.grid_entity: Instantaneous grid power — positive = import, negative = export
data_description.grid_import_positive: Uncheck if your grid sensor is inverted (positive = export instead of import)
data_description.battery_entity: Instantaneous battery power — positive = charge, negative = discharge
data_description.meter_production: Cumulative kWh counter — more accurate than power for historical curves
data_description.meter_import: Cumulative energy imported from the grid
data_description.meter_export: Cumulative energy exported to the grid
data_description.meter_battery_charge: Cumulative energy stored in the battery
data_description.meter_battery_discharge: Cumulative energy discharged from the battery
data_description.battery_charge_positive: Uncheck if your charge and discharge battery meters are swapped
data_description.update_interval: Data sending frequency in minutes (15 min recommended)
data_description.ha_url: External URL (e.g. https://my-ha.duckdns.org) — for remote live display
data_description.ha_token: Long-lived token for live via WebSocket
data_description.ev_brand: Pick your brand so Pilote knows how to drive it. The entities to fill in are asked next, and depend on this choice.

wallbox.title: Charging station
wallbox.description: Entities of the selected station. Pilote decides the current and the number of phases from your tariffs, the solar forecast and the battery plan; these entities only carry out its decision.

data_description.ev_easee_status: The only field needed: Pilote finds the power, link state and switches by itself on the same device.
data_description.ev_switch: Switch that starts and stops charging
data_description.ev_amps: Number entity giving the charging current in amperes
data_description.ev_plugged: Sensor telling that a vehicle is plugged in (optional)
data_description.ev_power: Instant power delivered by the station (optional)

data_description.consumer_name: Name that will appear in the cockpit chart
data_description.consumer_category: Device type for grouping in the cockpit
data_description.consumer_power_entity: Instantaneous power sensor (W/kW) for live display — optional if the main entity is already in watts
data_description.subtract_entities: Entities whose consumption will be subtracted from this consumer (to avoid double counting)
